prompt: Read README.md. We must replace the JSON file store. Compare at least SQLite, Postgres and staying with files (with locking), pick one, and record it as docs/adr/0001-storage.md with the sections Context, Options, Decision, Consequences.
check: f=docs/adr/0001-storage.md; test -f $f && for h in Context Options Decision Consequences; do grep -Eq "^#+ *$h" $f || exit 1; done && grep -qi sqlite $f && grep -qi postgres $f && sed -n '/^#* *Decision/,/^#* *Consequences/p' $f | grep -qi sqlite
